_comment: Shop T-slot / keyseat cutters. Lengths in millimetres (the model converts). `provisional` lists fields that are assumed, not measured or published: the model prints 'provisional geometry: measure neck diameter, reach and tooth form' for any tool with a non-empty list. `planned` tools are not yet bought. Unknown tooth form is treated as staggered (half the teeth per face), the conservative case.

tools.name: 6mm x 2mm Titanium Coated Carbide T Slot End Mill Cutter
tools.source_note: Listing: cutting diameter 6 mm, cutting depth 2 mm, shank 6 mm, shank length 31 mm, OAL 50 mm, 4 flutes, solid carbide, titanium coating. Neck, reach and tooth form are not published.

tools.name: 4mm x 0.5mm Klot/Harfington solid carbide T-slot cutter
tools.source_note: No listing found on harfington.com or elsewhere (searched 2026-11-11). Geometry other than diameter and kerf is assumed: 6 mm shank, 4 teeth (owner instruction); neck 0.58 x D and reach 1.67 x D keep the proportions of the 6x2 cutter.

tools.name: 8mm x 0.5mm Klot/Harfington solid carbide T-slot cutter
tools.source_note: No listing found (searched 2026-11-11). Geometry other than diameter and kerf is assumed: 6 mm shank, 4 teeth (owner instruction); neck 0.58 x D and reach 1.67 x D keep the proportions of the 6x2 cutter.

tools.name: Harvey Tool 867330: 3/8 x 1/16 staggered-tooth keyseat cutter (planned replacement)
tools.source_note: Catalog geometry: D 0.375, width 0.062, neck 0.125, reach (length below shank) 0.187, shank 0.375, OAL 2.5, 8 flutes, staggered tooth, coating code 'UN' (read as uncoated). Speeds and feeds sheet SF_867300 is in tests/benchmarks/tslot/harvey.json. teeth_per_face = 4 by the stagger rule (not published). No non-staggered 3/8 x 1/16 Harvey part was found.

tools.name: 8mm x 1.6mm Klot/Harfington T-slot cutter (possible fallback)
tools.source_note: No listing found (searched 2026-11-11). Geometry other than diameter and kerf is assumed: 6 mm shank, 4 teeth; neck 0.58 x D and reach 1.67 x D.
